## Checklist

- [ ] No new third-party dependency
- [ ] No em dash (U+2014) in anything under `Sources/`, including comments
- [ ] Any new permission or command line tool is registered in `SetupCenter`, not requested lazily on first use
- [ ] README updated if the change adds or changes a command
